title_en: The Gnostic Theory of the Unity of Existence (03)
summary: The third lesson in a series explaining the theory of the unity of existence (wahdat al-wujud) within the context of mystical gnosis ('irfan), specifically commenting on the work Fusus al-Hikam.
series_en: Explanation of Fusus al-Hikam: The Gnostic Theory of the Unity of Existence
